# IT Security and Database Optimization Protocol

This document outlines critical tasks for the IT & Digital department, focusing on security, performance, and infrastructure optimization.

## Key Action Items:

*   Review the firewall settings standard update.
*   Review the API latency quarterly.
*   Optimize the database migration for strategy 2026.
*   Investigate the API latency for strategy 2026.
*   Update the database migration quarterly.
